subject: black licorice
title: What If You Ate Black Licorice Every Day?

scenes.text: What if you ate black licorice every day? It's not the sugar that's the problem.
Real black licorice contains glycyrrhizin, a compound from licorice root.
Day after day, it makes your body flush out potassium.
Your heart needs potassium to keep its rhythm. Within about two weeks, it can start to stumble.
A US warning says two ounces a day for two weeks can cause heart rhythm problems in people over 40.
In 2020, doctors reported a 54-year-old man whose heart stopped after weeks of eating black licorice daily.

description:
What if you ate black licorice every day? Glycyrrhizin from licorice root lowers potassium, which can lead to high blood pressure and abnormal heart rhythms.
The FDA warns that two ounces a day for two weeks can cause heart rhythm problems in people over 40, and a 2020 NEJM case described a 54-year-old man who died after weeks of eating it.
